escalations.hypothesis: Round 1 alone used 257,820 tokens against a 250,000 round cap, so the run stopped before any fix round. The cap is too small for a task that fixes three defects together (C15, C12, C14) and also sent 12 failing tests back to the Test Author. What was left is mostly about tests, not the code: three of the four open findings say AC-5, AC-13 and AC-18 are claimed but have no k21 test files. The fourth finding, the `<=` round boundary at build-implement.js:370, looks wrong on its merits: AC-5 sets the round hard stop at strictly more than 2x, so allowing up to and including 2x before the hard stop matches the spec.
